description: Na₃V₂(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.92 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.11 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-41°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-34°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.55 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one V, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃VP trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one P atom.
